book.title: The Innovator's Solution
book.author: Clayton M. Christensen and Michael E. Raynor

predict.question: Your company weighs a big bet, plan B: a 20% chance it pays 100 credits, otherwise it loses 40. On average, what does plan B net?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: The Innovator’s Solution examines why opportunities can motivate entrants and incumbents differently.
modelBoundary: A averages {A}; B averages {B}. Both have the same 20% favorable branch; the larger unfavorable commitment changes the sign of the expected net. The asymmetric losses are invented; no firm-size effect or market outcome is estimated.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
